audit.whatIsWrong: Six places say Path Maker (W) blocks Neeko's abilities — 'his W blocks your Tangle-Barbs root', 'K'Sante's W can block the slam', 'his W-block isolation', 'Block your Tangle-Barbs root and Pop Blossom slam with his W'. Path Maker is not a block or a spell shield: Riot's text is that he charges up taking reduced damage, then dashes, knocking back and stunning.
audit.why: This is the single most load-bearing claim on the page and it is false. Damage reduction while charging does not negate a root or a knock-up. The real interaction is the opposite shape — he charges through your poke and answers with a knock-back stun, and while All Out that stun is gone entirely, which is a window rather than a wall. Telling a player their root gets blocked makes them hold the one ability that actually works.
audit.corrected: whys[2], whys[4], whys[5], spikes[0].text, wants.foe[0], content.early, content.mid and report[5].t now state the charge-and-stun, and that All Out removes the knock-back and stun.
sources: kit: K'Sante W text and flags

audit.whatIsWrong: Four places describe a 'Q knockup' and 'percent-HP passive autos'. Ntofo Strikes slows in a short line and, at two stacks, fires a shockwave that pulls enemies in — a pull, not a knock-up. Dauntless Instinct marks targets to take more damage on his next attack; there is no percent-health damage anywhere in the kit.
audit.why: Both errors are the kind that make a player misplay spacing: a pull and a knock-up want opposite positioning, and 'percent-HP' tells a squishy Neeko her HP bar does not matter when in fact stacking HP is fine here.
audit.corrected: whys[0], whys[1] and spikes[2].text now name Ntofo Strikes with its 3.5s cooldown, the second-stack pull, and the marked-attack passive.
sources: kit: K'Sante Q text, cd 3.5, range 450

audit.why: The row contradicts its own text and its mirror. Neeko's E plus Pop Blossom is AoE against a single-target isolation ultimate, which is exactly what the late text argues.

edits.before: K'Sante owns these levels and you have to respect it. At level 1 you only have single-target Q and no combo, so don't contest his Q knockup or his percent-HP passive autos — last-hit at the edge of Q range and eat a little poke. By level 3 you have Q + E (Tangle-Barbs), so you can threaten a root-into-Q-bloom trade if he steps up to CS, but his W can block your root entirely, so only throw E when it's the only thing he can react to. Don't waste W (Shapesplitter) clone+invis early; save it to dodge his Q.
edits.after: K'Sante owns these levels and you have to respect it. At level 1 you only have single-target Q and no combo, so don't contest Ntofo Strikes or his marked-attack autos — last-hit at the edge of Q range and eat a little poke. By level 3 you have Q + E (Tangle-Barbs), so you can threaten a root-into-Q-bloom trade if he steps up to CS, but Path Maker charges through it and answers with a knock-back stun, so throw E only when he has already spent that 14s. Don't waste W (Shapesplitter) early; save it to bait his Q.

edits.before: You're still behind through 4-5 because you won't all-in without ult and his sustain eats your Q poke. At 6, Pop Blossom is your one real kill window — set it up while disguised or invisible via W so he can't pre-block, land E to root, then Q-bloom into the slam stun. Be honest, though: a good K'Sante W-blocks the root or the slam and his R yanks you out of clone range, so don't force the all-in into his cooldowns. If 6 doesn't connect, shove the wave and roam — your disguise pressure wins other lanes.
edits.after: You're still behind through 4-5 because you won't all-in without ult and his sustain eats your Q poke. At 6, Pop Blossom is your one real kill window — set it up disguised, since your passive hides the wind-up entirely, land E to root, then Q-bloom into the slam stun. Be honest, though: a good K'Sante answers with Path Maker's knock-back stun, and All Out launches you through a wall and follows, so don't commit into a fresh 14s W. If 6 doesn't connect, shove and roam — your disguise pressure wins other lanes.

notes: The 'W blocks your root' claim was the calibration-grade error here: it appeared in six fields and it is flatly contradicted by Riot's own text for Path Maker. Worth knowing for the rest of the champion: All Out removes Path Maker's knock-back and stun, so a K'Sante who has ulted is the safest time to land Tangle-Barbs. Two flagged interactions I did not have length-safe room for and left alone: Footwork (E, 8-10s) shields and should be baited before committing, and Dauntless Instinct is an attack-reset burst tell — both belong on this page if anyone has spare fields. Also unchanged: the full layer calls Neeko 'he/his' in several inherited template strings, as the mirror's author noted.
